scripts.dev: npm run index && concurrently -k -n web,server -c blue,green "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:server"
scripts.dev:web: npm run index && npm run dev -w @karol-learn/web
scripts.build: npm run pruefen && npm run index && npm run build -w @karol-learn/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c apps/web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.hooks: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo "hooks: .githooks aktiv (pre-commit = pruefen + test)"
